info.prompt: Wide cinematic shot of the Frenzy Mode activation: the entire neo-gothic interface fractures like shattering obsidian as players' energy meters spike into crimson overload, with hexagonal prism orbs (Rainbow Bombs) materializing mid-air while neural connections between players' avatars crackle with overloaded cyan electricity, all framed by the ivory sanctuary lobby crumbling into the background like a collapsing cathedral.
